Privacy
Policy.

Last updated: 21 October 2026

We collect the minimum data needed to run this independent guide and to understand use in aggregate.

Information we collect

This may include basic browsing information such as IP address, browser type and pages visited; cookies and similar technologies. This site has no account, booking form or contact form.

How we use it

We use it to improve site content and experience, understand aggregate usage patterns, and meet applicable legal obligations.

Third-party services

This site uses Google Fonts for typefaces and may embed Google Maps for location mapping. Google Analytics is loaded only when you allow analytics cookies. These services maintain their own privacy policies.

Your rights

Under the GDPR and relevant regulations, you may request access, correction or deletion of personal data, object to certain processing, or lodge a complaint with a relevant authority.

Cloudflare hosting performance

Cloudflare hosting injects a Cloudflare Insights (RUM) beacon separately from Google Analytics. It may send page performance metrics, URLs and referrers to Cloudflare. Cloudflare documents that the beacon uses no cookies or browser storage and discards the request IP address at its nearest data center. This site’s Google Analytics control does not control the hosting beacon. Script presence does not establish successful metric delivery.

Cloudflare RUM documentation · checked 21 October 2026

INDEPENDENT GUIDE

This is an independent, non-profit visitor-guide project. It is not affiliated with any government body or official site operator.

PUBLIC REFERENCES

Information draws on Indonesia.travel, Pontianak City’s 23 March 2026 event report and a Maps listing checked 19 October 2026. It contains no commercial recommendations.
